<!-- Generated by npm run design-system:sync from components/design-system/Hero.md. Edit that file, not this one. -->
The navy banner at the top of an event's overview: the event's state, name, dates and place, with a capacity card beside it.

- `.event-hero` is a 24px-radius banner on a navy-to-teal gradient with white text, a faint gold ring in the top right corner, and `--shadow`. The copy (`.hero-copy`) sits at the left and `.hero-capacity` at the right. On screens 800px wide or narrower the two stack and the corners become 20px.
- The copy is an `.event-state` pill (translucent gold, for example "Registration open"), an `h2` (white, 1.65rem to 2.25rem) and `.hero-meta`: a calendar icon, the dates, a dot and the place or "Location pending".
- `.hero-eyebrow` (purple uppercase label, pale blue inside a hero) is the small label above a title.
- `.hero-capacity` is a translucent card, at least 200px wide, with a small uppercase "Capacity" label, the count ("148 / 200", or "Open" when no limit is set) and a `.capacity-track` bar filled gold to the share used.
- Text inside a hero is white or pale blue on navy, and the focus ring there is gold.
- The Check-in tally banner uses the same gradient and corners (`.checkin-hero`). The public registration and account pages have their own heroes (see `PublicHome`).
